groups.title: DISA STIG for Oracle Linux 8 - Account and Authentication Module

controls.title: OL 8 must not allow accounts configured with blank or null passwords.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 must not allow accounts configured with blank or null passwords.

controls.title: OL 8 must encrypt all stored passwords with a FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic hashing algorithm.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 must encrypt all stored passwords with a FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic hashing algorithm.

controls.title: OL 8 systems, versions 8.2 and above, must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 systems, versions 8.2 and above, must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur.

controls.title: OL 8 passwords must have a minimum of 15 characters.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 passwords must have a minimum of 15 characters.

controls.title: OL 8 passwords for new users or password changes must have a 24 hours/one day minimum password lifetime restriction in "/etc/login.defs".

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 passwords for new users or password changes must have a 24 hours/one day minimum password lifetime restriction in "/etc/login.defs".

controls.title: OL 8 systems, versions 8.2 and above, must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur during a 15-minute time period.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 systems, versions 8.2 and above, must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur during a 15-minute time period.

controls.title: OL 8 duplicate User IDs (UIDs) must not exist for interactive users.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 duplicate User IDs (UIDs) must not exist for interactive users.

controls.title: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one uppercase character be used.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one uppercase character be used.

controls.title: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one lowercase character be used.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one lowercase character be used.

controls.title: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one numeric character be used.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: OL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one numeric character be used.

controls.title: All OL 8 passwords must contain at least one special character.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: All OL 8 passwords must contain at least one special character.

parts.prose: OL 8 must restrict access to the kernel message buffer.

parts.prose: OL 8 must disable IEEE 1394 (FireWire) Support.
